title: The Necessary Glasshouse
author: Felix Ishikawa
blurb: Theo Underhill, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
